description: Soundboard resonance modes (damped harmonic oscillators) as served by GET /get_parameter/mode.

domains.title: Resonance modes
domains.write: param.set {parameter: mode, key_no, values} (values = {mode: {frequency?, decrement?, mass_inv?, radiance_mono?, radiance_left?, radiance_right?, radiance_stereo?}})
domains.key_space: MODE index 0..num_modes-1 (not a pitch; the only domain keyed by mode)
domains.stored_vs_effective: frequency, decrement and mass_inv are stored; stiffness and damping are derived (read-only); mass is a read-only legacy alias of mass_inv. Mode edits are physics edits: they do NOT clear output_scale_calibrated.

fields.name: frequency
fields.units: Hz, as a small-angle parameter: the mode plays acos(1 - omega/2)*sr/(2*pi) Hz, sharp of frequency by about (pi*f/sr)^2/6 (+1 cent at 1 kHz, +100 cents at 8.9 kHz, 48 kHz)
fields.meaning: Mode frequency; moving it moves that partial of the output.

fields.name: decrement
fields.range: >= 0 (< 0 rejected 400: negative damping grows without bound); finite
fields.meaning: Mode damping; decrement up -> that band's decay time tau down.

envelope.note: validity only (a negative decrement = a growing mode); no step limit

fields.name: mass_inv
fields.units: UNKNOWN (inverse-mass coefficient 1/m on the preset's calibration scale, not SI)
fields.meaning: Inverse-mass coefficient multiplying the applied force (q'' + 2*gamma*q' + omega^2*q = mass_inv * F); UI label 1/mass; up -> louder mode.

fields.name: radiance_mono
fields.units: linear amplitude gain (dimensionless); speaker drive per unit engine mode signal (basis absolute) or per unit board motion (basis board_motion, see output.get_mode)
fields.range: >= 0, finite (negative = a polarity flip, rejected; no cap: absolute factors are in engine row units, ~1e4); default 1 (absent in old presets)
fields.meaning: Speaker radiance factor of the mode in the mono layout: the speaker channel row is g*r[m] (x b[m] for board_motion), g = energy match to the exciter channels + trim. Inert in output target board. A radiance-only edit uploads no mode physics.

fields.name: radiance_left
fields.meaning: Left-speaker radiance factor of the mode in the stereo layout. GET returns the EFFECTIVE value (= radiance_mono until a stereo pair is set); setting it stores an explicit pair [L, R] (preset key radiance_stereo) whose other side keeps its effective value. POST also accepts radiance_stereo [L, R] (null = back to following mono).

fields.name: radiance_right
fields.meaning: Right-speaker radiance factor of the mode in the stereo layout (see radiance_left).

fields.name: radiance_stereo
fields.units: [L, R] linear amplitude gains, as radiance_mono; null = follows radiance_mono
fields.meaning: The STORED stereo pair behind radiance_left / radiance_right (GET returns it; preset key radiance_stereo, written only when set). POST [L, R] sets the pair; null clears it (back to following mono). Undo of an L / R edit restores it exactly, incl. null (dev-rad2).

fields.name: stiffness
fields.meaning: Derived read-only: stiffness = mass_inv * (2*pi*f)^2 (mass_inv plays the role of m in this calibration convention).

fields.name: mass
fields.meaning: Legacy GET alias with the same value as mass_inv; a POSTed 'mass' is still accepted with a deprecation warning, 'mass_inv' is preferred.
